newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INTER PRESIDENT PROMISES NEW PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INTER PRESIDENT PROMISES NEW PLAYERS.

text.p: Inter president Massimo Moratti, who spent a fortune on players over the summer, has promised the serie A leaders fresh signings.
Italian newspapers quoted Moratti as telling the club's annual general meeting in Milan on Wednesday that he had hoped to announce a major new signing at the gathering.
"But then I realised that I would have hurt a fellow president. So I restrained myself," he said.
"But we still intend to strengthen Inter. Players will be arriving and players will be leaving."
Newspapers said the big name signing hinted at by Moratti was almost certainly from an Italian club and mentioned Sampdoria striker Roberto Mancini as the most likely candidate.
The Milan daily Corriere della Sera also mentioned Parma's Italy striker Gianfranco Zola as another possibility.
Moratti was quoted as saying that he regretted Inter's decision not to sign Brazilian sensation Ronaldo, although he said Barcelona had wanted far too much money.

"The amount asked by Barcelona was madness. Inter does not have Fiat or (state energy company) ENI behind it...it was not a signing I thought I could make, although now having seen his goals I might be tempted to think again," he said.

Inter, currently joint league leaders with Juventus, spent around $24 million over the summer on big name stars, including Chilean striker Ivan Zamorano from Real Madrid and French international Youri Djorkaeff.

They already had England midfielder Paul Ince and Argentine Javier Zanetti on their books. Dutchman Aron Winter, France's Jocelyn Angloma and Swiss Ciriaco Sforza are other big-name foreign internationals at the club.
Despite the spending spree, Inter struggled to reach the third round of the UEFA Cup on Tuesday night, beating unfancied Austrians Casino Graz on a penalty shoot-out.

Zamorano has only recently begun scoring goals for Inter however while another star signing, Nigerian international Nwankwo Kanu, was sidelined before the start of the season when he was diagnosed with a serious heart problem.
Doctors have said Kanu may never play again.
